description: Task: write a Python function solve(n, edges) that returns True if an undirected graph contains a cycle and False otherwise. The nodes are the integers 0 to n - 1, with 1 <= n <= 1000. The argument edges is a list of pairs [u, v] with 0 <= u, v < n and u != v; 0 <= len(edges) <= 2000 and no pair of nodes is joined twice. The graph need not be connected, and a cycle in any part of it counts.

spec_text:
Task: write a Python function solve(n, edges) that returns True if an undirected graph contains a cycle and False otherwise. The nodes are the integers 0 to n - 1, with 1 <= n <= 1000. The argument edges is a list of pairs [u, v] with 0 <= u, v < n and u != v; 0 <= len(edges) <= 2000 and no pair of nodes is joined twice. The graph need not be connected, and a cycle in any part of it counts.

Use only the Python standard library. Return only one ```python code block containing the function solve and any helpers, with no example usage and no explanation.

catalogue.mechanism: depth-first traversal that reports a cycle on reaching a visited node other than the parent
breadth-first traversal with a FIFO queue that reports a cycle on reaching a visited node other than the parent
union the endpoints of each edge; an edge whose endpoints already share a root closes a cycle
find the components and report a cycle when some component has at least as many edges as nodes
